points.reason: The CSR write command is decoded into tx_fifo_we, so altering or suppressing this decision can change or block a transmit-queue write; it does not expose the command or implement a special behavior.

csr_addr_i selects whether the readback is status or receive data, so changing this selection retargets the CSR command, but the process does not itself block the read or implement a special behavior.

The acknowledgement field is asserted only for a matching CSR read, so tampering can acknowledge an unintended access or withhold acknowledgement and block the transfer; it does not expose the command or provide a special behavior.
